page_title: NEW 3-0 FUL | Newcastle v Fulham 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' A quickly taken corner by Newcastle.

90+6' What an opportunity! Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the bottom left corner, but Bernd Leno reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
90+4' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
90+3' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
87' Some neat passing and movement from Newcastle as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
84' Substitution. Anthony Gordon did his best and is replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
84' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Dan Burn will be replaced by Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd).
84' That will be all from Valentino Livramento who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd).
82' 3 - 0 Goal! Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.

82' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. Bernd Leno shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
82' The attendance for today's match is 52055.
81' Booking. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) receives a caution from the referee.
79' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) produces a cross from the resulting free kick from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper smothers the ball.
78' Issa Diop (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Samuel Barrott signals a set piece. Newcastle have a free kick.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alex Iwobi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham).
76' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Joao Palhinha and he is replaced by Harrison Reed (Fulham).
76' Substitution. Tom Cairney is replaced by Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
76' The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
75' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Newcastle have a corner.

73' Tom Cairney (Fulham) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.

72' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Samuel Barrott stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Fulham are awarded the free kick.

71' So close! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
70' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) picks up a yellow card.
69' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
69' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

68' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Newcastle get a free kick.

67' Tom Cairney (Fulham) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Martin Dubravka pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
66' No offside! Referee Samuel Barrott points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Newcastle players celebrate.
65' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Newcastle players aren’t happy.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Anthony Gordon puts the ball across the area and Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:0.
62' Kenny Tete (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Martin Dubravka comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Here is a change. Timothy Castagne is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kenny Tete (Fulham) replaces Andreas Pereira.
60' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
57' 1 - 0 Goal Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd)! Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) was put through by Bruno Guimaraes and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
54' Newcastle earn a corner.
54' Harry Wilson (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

53' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Bernd Leno pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
50' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Bernd Leno stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
49' The corner from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is hurriedly cleared.
47' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
47' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The whistle blows and Samuel Barrott starts the second half.
45+10' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+10' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
45+7' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
45+6' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) wastes a huge opportunity from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the left post.
45+5' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45+3' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and it's Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45+2' An accurate cross picks out Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
44' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
44' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Newcastle! Let's see what he decides.
43' Bernd Leno pulls off a great save to deny Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
43' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
42' Tom Cairney (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
42' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
41' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fulham force a corner. They send men into the box.
38' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
36' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Lewis Miley replaces him.
35' The game is interrupted now, Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Martin Dubravka anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

33' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Bernd Leno, who pulls off a comfortable save!

32' A long pass finds Joao Palhinha (Fulham), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the right side of the goal, but Martin Dubravka reacts well to make a good save.
30' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the bar!
28' 2:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
28' One of the players from Newcastle times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
24' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
22' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Raul Jimenez (Fulham). He’s got to go!

22' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Raul Jimenez (Fulham), but referee Samuel Barrott must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
21' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
17' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) controls a great pass from Anthony Gordon on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
14' Problems for Eddie Howe as Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Emil Krafth replaces him.
14' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
13' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Martin Dubravka intercepts the ball.
11' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to find Miguel Almiron, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
10' A free kick into the box, taken by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' Samuel Barrott blows the whistle, Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) is penalised for a foul. Newcastle win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
8' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

6' A big opportunity is wasted by Raul Jimenez (Fulham), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Martin Dubravka pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
5' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
4' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) trips an opposition player and Samuel Barrott signals a foul. Newcastle earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott was nominated as the referee for this game.
